title: AI Travel Assistant
subtitle: AI-Powered Travel Recommendation & Booking Solution
category: Customer-facing solution | AI | APIs | Payments | Recommendation Engine
customerProblem:
Travelers often need to compare destinations, hotels, flights and activities across multiple sources while staying within a specific budget. This creates a fragmented discovery and decision-making experience.

The objective was to create a solution that could understand customer preferences, budget constraints and travel requirements and turn them into relevant travel recommendations.
solution:
I designed and developed an AI-powered travel assistant that collects customer requirements and provides personalized travel recommendations based on budget, destination preferences and travel interests.

The solution combines an AI service with application APIs and a payment workflow to demonstrate how multiple technical capabilities can work together within a customer-facing product.

solutionArchitecture.diagram: Customer → React Application → Application/Proxy Layer → External APIs & AI Service → Recommendation Response
solutionArchitecture.description: The architecture separates the customer-facing application from external service integrations, allowing API credentials and service communication to be handled more securely.

challenges: The main challenges involved integrating an AI service reliably, protecting API credentials, improving the consistency of AI-generated recommendations and connecting the application to a payment workflow.
solutionApproach: I introduced a proxy layer between the frontend and external services so sensitive API credentials were not exposed directly in the browser.
I also refined the prompts used by the AI service, tested different customer scenarios and iterated on the recommendation flow to improve the relevance of the responses.
For the payment workflow, I integrated Paystack's test environment and validated different transaction scenarios before connecting the payment experience to the application flow.
businessValue:
The project demonstrates how customer requirements can be translated into a technical solution that combines AI, APIs, third-party integrations and payments into a single customer experience.

It also demonstrates my ability to explain technical architecture and integration decisions in terms of their impact on the customer experience.

title: Recipe Finder
subtitle: API-Driven Recipe Discovery Solution
customerProblem: Users looking for recipes need a fast way to search for meals, discover relevant options and access supporting cooking resources without navigating multiple sources.
solution:
I built an API-driven recipe discovery application that allows users to search for meals, receive relevant recipe results and access additional cooking resources.

The project focuses on integrating an external API into a responsive customer-facing application while managing application state and API requests efficiently.
challenges: The application needed to handle frequent search input and API requests without creating unnecessary network calls or component re-renders. Other requirements included predictable state management, responsive design and reliable API data handling.
solutionApproach: I implemented debounced search to reduce unnecessary API requests and used memoization to minimize avoidable component re-renders.
React Query was used for server-state management, caching and refetching, while Context API provided predictable application state management.
businessValue: The project demonstrates my ability to evaluate a technical requirement, select appropriate implementation approaches, integrate third-party APIs, troubleshoot technical issues and improve the customer experience through performance optimization.
